MSI.Settings.Style.Name: Indicator style
MSI.Settings.Style.Hint: Follow the token's transparent image silhouette (default), draw a ring, or use four corner marks.
MSI.Settings.Thickness.Name: Line thickness
MSI.Settings.Thickness.Hint: Thickness relative to Foundry's normal token border.
MSI.Settings.Opacity.Name: Opacity
MSI.Settings.Padding.Name: Indicator padding
MSI.Settings.Padding.Hint: Distance from the token edge as a percentage of the token's smallest dimension.
MSI.Preview.Hint: Preview the current values on the canvas without saving or closing this window.
MSI.Preview.Applied: Preview applied. Use Save Changes to keep these values.
MSI.Settings.CustomDispositionColors.Hin: Off: use the Foundry color for each token's disposition. On: use the editable colors below for selected and hovered tokens.
MSI.Settings.FRIENDLY.Name: Friendly token color
MSI.Settings.FRIENDLY.Hint: Override the normal friendly disposition color when custom colors are enabled.
MSI.Settings.NEUTRAL.Name: Neutral token color
MSI.Settings.NEUTRAL.Hint: Override the normal neutral disposition color when custom colors are enabled.
MSI.Settings.HOSTILE.Name: Hostile token color
MSI.Settings.HOSTILE.Hint: Override the normal hostile disposition color when custom colors are enabled.
MSI.Settings.SECRET.Name: Secret token color
MSI.Settings.SECRET.Hint: Override the normal secret disposition color when custom colors are enabled.
MSI.Settings.contourWidth.Name: Main outline thickness
MSI.Settings.contourWidth.Hint: Thickness of the main silhouette outline, in canvas pixels.
MSI.Settings.contrastWidth.Name: Outer contrast outline thickness
MSI.Settings.contrastWidth.Hint: Thickness of the contrasting outer edge, in canvas pixels.
MSI.Settings.contourOpacity.Name: Silhouette outline opacity
MSI.Settings.playerCharacterColors.Name: Use separate PC silhouette colors
MSI.Settings.playerCharacterColors.Hint: Characters owned by players receive white main and black outer outlines by default. Disable to use disposition colors instead.
MSI.Settings.playerMainColor.Name: PC main outline color
MSI.Settings.playerMainColor.Hint: Main color for player character silhouette outlines (white by default).
MSI.Settings.playerContrastColor.Name: PC outer outline color
MSI.Settings.playerContrastColor.Hint: Outer contrast color for player characters (black by default).
MSI.Settings.otherContrastColor.Name: Other token outer outline color
MSI.Settings.otherContrastColor.Hint: Outer contrasting edge for non-PC tokens; their main color follows disposition.
